## Tofu burritos

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-maturing-orange.svg){fig-align="left"}](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#maturing)

### Ingredients

-   Onion
-   Garlic
-   Chilli (small with seeds)
-   Tofu
-   Beef stock
-   Cumin
-   Cayenne pepper
-   Paprika
-   Salt
-   Coriander
-   Miso paste
-   Oregano
-   Black beans
-   Beer (Australian lager) (\<1/2 cup)
-   Lime juice (1/2 lime)
-   Butter (50g) or olive oil
-   1 dessert spoon corn flour

### Steps

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Pressure cooker

1.  Soak ground tofu in 1/2 cup of strong beef-style stock.
2.  Brown onion in oil. Add garlic and chilli.
3.  Add spices and salt. Cook for a while.
4.  Add tofu and miso paste. Cook until stock/water begins to boil off.
5.  Add Black beans, beer and lime juice. Boil off much of the remaining fluid. Stir and let settle. Add corn flour.
6.  Add butter or additional oil. Stir in.
7.  Pressure cook 20 mins (TBC).

## Stovetop

1.  Soak ground tofu in 1/2 cup of strong beef-style stock.
2.  Brown onion in oil. Add garlic and chilli.
3.  Add spices and salt. Cook for a while.
4.  Add tofu and miso paste. Cook until stock/water begins to boil off.
5.  Add Black beans, beer and lime juice. Boil off much of the remaining fluid. Stir and let settle. Add corn flour.
6.  Add butter or additional oil. Stir in.
7.  Simmer covered on low ~30 mins, stirring occasionally, until the flavours meld (or slow cook ~3 h).

:::

### Sources

-   Inspired by: https://www.wellplated.com/tofu-tacos/

## Chilli

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-maturing-orange.svg){fig-align="left"}](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#maturing)

### Ingredients

-   Onion
-   Garlic
-   Red + green chilli
-   Capsicum
-   Cumin powder
-   Cayenne pepper
-   Coriander
-   Oregano
-   Paprika
-   Cinnamon
-   Brown sugar
-   Salt
-   Miso paste
-   Soy sauce
-   1 star anise
-   cocoa powder
-   brown sugar (1 large tsp)
-   Butter
-   Tomato diced (2 cans)
-   Tomato paste
-   Tofu (1 packet)
-   Beef stock (1/2 cup)
-   Beer (1/2 cup)
-   Beans (2 cans; black + kidney)

### Steps

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Pressure cooker

1.  Brown onion, garlic, and chilli. Add in capsicum.
2.  Add spices/herbs to taste.
3.  Add tofu, tomato, beer, miso, soy sauce, sugar and stock. Stir until heated. Add butter and allow to melt.
4.  Cook on high pressure for 20 minutes. Allow to naturally release pressure \~10 min.
5.  Taste and add spices as required. Add beans and cook for another 10 mins.
6.  Naturally release pressure. Brown to remove any extra liquid.

## Stovetop

1.  Brown onion, garlic, and chilli. Add in capsicum.
2.  Add spices/herbs to taste.
3.  Add tofu, tomato, beer, miso, soy sauce, sugar and stock. Stir until heated. Add butter and allow to melt.
4.  Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook ~40 mins, stirring occasionally.
5.  Taste and add spices as required. Add beans and simmer a further ~15 mins.
6.  Uncover and reduce to remove any extra liquid.

:::

## Mexican-style rice

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-maturing-orange.svg){fig-align="left"}](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#maturing)

### Ingredients

-   Onion
-   Garlic
-   Chilli
-   Peas + corn
-   Oregano
-   Cumin
-   Cinnamon
-   Paprika
-   Salt
-   Pepper
-   Tomato paste
-   Tomato
-   Lemon
-   Beans (red and kidney)
-   Rice (1 cup)
-   Chicken stock (1.5 cups)

### Steps

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Pressure cooker

1.  Brown onion. Add garlic and chilli. Then add peas + corn.
2.  Add spices and stir until aromatic.
3.  Add tomato, tomato paste, lemon, beans, rice and chicken stock. Stir to combine.
4.  Pressure cook for 4 minutes.

## Stovetop

1.  Brown onion. Add garlic and chilli. Then add peas + corn.
2.  Add spices and stir until aromatic.
3.  Add tomato, tomato paste, lemon, beans, rice and chicken stock (use ~2 cups liquid for the stovetop). Stir to combine.
4.  Bring to a boil, then reduce to low, cover, and cook ~18--20 mins until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Rest covered 5 mins, then fluff.

:::

## Guacamole

[![](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-stable-green.svg){fig-align="left"}](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#stable)

### Ingredients

- Onion
- Chilli
- Coriander
- Salt
- Tomato
- Avocado
- Cumin (1/2 teaspoon, max)
- Lime juice

### Steps

1. Mince onion, chilli, coriander and salt together, ideally with a mortar and pestle
1. Add to a bowl with tomatoes, additional onion, 1/4 of the avocado, and cumin. Mix together into a reasonably consistent mix.
1. Add remaining avocado so that it remains chunky. You may want to use different avocado chunk sizes.
1. Add lime juice.
